name: stockpro-monorepo
description: Root configuration to run all servers concurrently in one terminal

scripts.dev: npx concurrently -c "blue,magenta,yellow,cyan" -n "BACKEND,REVERB,REACT,AI-ENGN" "cd backend && php artisan serve" "cd backend && php artisan reverb:start --port=8090" "cd frontend && npm run dev" "cd ai-engine && venv\Scripts\activate && python chatbot.py"
